positions.name: RehearsalAsRealityGate
positions.frame: Does performed rehearsal serve as the condition that makes a rollback capability real?
positions.why: Both the directive and its recorded cadence decision express the same operational commitment: monthly rollback rehearsals are mandated because rehearsal is what makes a rollback capability actual rather than theoretical. The directive (src-1) establishes the principle and the cadence; the summary (src-3) records the cadence as a settled decision. The frame holds both the authoritative maxim and its compressed restatement.
